changelog:
- Initial public release of the humanizer skill.
- Detects and rewrites common AI writing patterns to sound more human, based on Wikipedia’s “Signs of AI writing”.
- Addresses issues like promotional tone, inflated symbolism, vague attributions, and formulaic outlines.
- Provides guidance for adding authentic voice and personality to writing, not just removing AI markers.
- Includes specific before-and-after examples for all major patterns.
